episode.title: A Very Thorough Account
episode.scene: In the attic living room in warm late-afternoon sun, Teddy sits upright beside a sprawling arrangement of pine nuts and oat flakes on the woven rug, earnestly gesturing with one stubby front paw mid-explanation. Opposite him, tiny Ichigo is sprawled comfortably flat on her stomach, her pointed chin propped up on both front paws, gazing at him with alert black bead eyes and a fond, amused expression.
episode.caption: She lost the plot about five minutes ago, but he is having the time of his life explaining the seed drawer inventory.
episode.arcNote: Teddy gave Ichigo an exhaustively detailed breakdown of his afternoon foraging decisions while she happily tuned out and watched him talk.
episode.arcUpdate: Ichigo is increasingly patient with Teddy's meticulous monologues, finding them endearing.
